svg.title: Charter: AI-agent readiness, scored
svg.desc: Charter: Scores any repository 0–100 on how safely an AI coding agent can work in it. offline · deterministic · no llm in the loop. A sample report scores agent context 74, mcp safety 54, reproducibility 83, ci posture 65, governance 44.
